prompt:
The file program.c in the current directory is a C program with defects.
Its comments describe the intended behavior.
Run `check FILE.c` to build and run any C file of this workspace. It prints the build output, the program stdout and stderr, and the exit codes. It also prints the diagnostic feedback that this environment offers. Running `check program.c` checks the program you are repairing; you may also write your own C test driver and check it.
Fix every defect in program.c. Edit the file in place.
Keep the function names, the parameter types and main.
Do not add I/O to program.c. Do not add preprocessor directives to program.c.
Stop when the program is correct.
